name: Workspace File Operations
description: Read, write, create, and delete files within the opened workspace with path traversal guards.
installGuidance: Enabled by default. No install required. Restricts operations to the workspace root unless you explicitly approve an outside path.

name: AI Diff Review
description: Shows AI-proposed edits as reviewable diffs. Accept or reject before any file is overwritten.
installGuidance: Always on for AI edits. No configuration required.

name: Integrated Terminal
description: Local shell panel. AI-initiated commands require explicit user approval before execution.
installGuidance: Uses the system shell. Approve AI command cards before they run.

name: Workspace Search
description: Keyword search across open workspace files with line previews.
installGuidance: No install required. Search is limited to the current workspace.

name: LM Studio Provider
description: OpenAI-compatible local model provider. Default base URL http://localhost:1234/v1.
installGuidance: Install LM Studio separately, load a model, and start the local server. Configure base URL in Settings.

name: Explicit Context Picker
description: Only user-selected files are sent as model context. Nothing is attached silently.
installGuidance: Select files in the AI panel before prompting.

name: Infinite Canvas (Experimental)
description: Spatial file map with focus lens and satellite cards for large workspaces.
installGuidance: Enable in the Tools catalog to show the Canvas view. Experimental polish layer.

name: Ambient Intent Radial
description: Quick intent menu for common AI actions near the caret.
installGuidance: Enable in catalog; press Ctrl+Shift+Space in the editor for the intent radial.

name: Dynamic Syntax Dimming
description: Dims inactive scopes to emphasize the active editing region.
installGuidance: Toggle in catalog. Applies a focus CSS class to the editor pane.

name: TypeScript / JavaScript
description: Monaco syntax highlighting and language detection for TS/JS/TSX/JSX.
installGuidance: Bundled with Monaco. No extra install.

name: Python
description: Monaco syntax highlighting for Python source files.
installGuidance: Bundled with Monaco. No extra install.

name: Git Status Badge
description: Shows dirty workspace hint when .git is present. Does not run network git operations.
installGuidance: Reads local .git presence only. No remotes contacted.

name: MCP Tool Dock
description: Browse the MCP catalog and connect local stdio MCP servers (command + args). Lists tools; does not invent remote credentials.
installGuidance: Enable this item, open the MCP chip in the tool dock, then Add server with a local command (e.g. npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /path). Refresh tools to probe over stdio.

name: Local stdio MCP client
description: Built-in client that spawns user-configured local MCP servers and calls initialize + tools/list.
installGuidance: No separate install. Configure servers in the MCP dock. Tool invocation beyond listing is not executed automatically.

name: Filesystem MCP (example)
description: Example local MCP server using the official filesystem package via npx. Configure path yourself.
installGuidance: In MCP dock → Add server: command=npx, args=-y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /absolute/workspace/path. Requires network only for the first npx fetch; runtime is local stdio.

name: Remote Cloud Models
description: Opt-in OpenAI-compatible remote endpoint (base URL + API key) via Settings. Never used as a silent fallback from local mode.
installGuidance: Settings → Provider mode → Remote. Enter base URL and API key (stored locally, never logged). Select a discovered model to chat.

name: Online tools & extensions
description: Allow enabling online/cloud catalog tools. Only available while a remote cloud model is active.
installGuidance: Switch to Remote provider mode, select a model, then Enable. Disabled automatically when you return to local LM Studio.
